name: se2
description: Plan repository-scoped Features and vertical Tasks, then hand off verified Task execution through a shared application preflight contract.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Features and execute Tasks through verified handoffs.
interface.longDescription: SE2 is an experimental issue-first, graph-first Feature planning plugin with a separate Task implementation entry point. Its Feature skill starts from repository AGENTS.md context, keeps a Mermaid overview, a canonical node registry, and one standard Markdown contract for every workflow step. It converges one repository-owned Feature issue containing the canonical Feature definition with vertical Task issues, an acyclic Task dependency graph, readiness evidence, coordinated multi-repository Feature links, and an internally verified GitHub publication step when explicitly authorized. Root plugin contracts standardize live task preflight, destination and identity observation, update relay, and reconciliation; each skill owns its task profile and topology.
defaultPrompt: Use $se2:feature for an explicit Feature or Feature maintenance run: load repository AGENTS.md context, pass the skill-owned task profile through the shared task preflight when a task handoff is needed, converge repository-owned Feature issues and vertical Task dependency graphs, and return the complete bundle with GitHub verification only when publication is explicitly authorized.

Use $se2:implement only for an explicit SE2 Task implementation request; load the same root task preflight and handoff contracts and fail closed when live creation, observation, or monitoring cannot be verified.
